evidence_and_limits: React/TypeScript/Vite, local Tailwind/Radix-compatible components, Lucide, TanStack Query/Table, Router and Recharts. Resolved versions locked.
Navy navigation, white surfaces, restrained teal accents, local system fonts, responsive layouts and inspected screenshots.
Actual messages, timestamps, internal scrolling, disabled pending composer/context controls, retry, suggestions, rich results, owner-bound context and reset.
Existing conversation/message and reset endpoints. Backend handles all intent/entity/context interpretation; no frontend NLP imitation.
Actual service/operator/category/segment/times/dates/fares; missing vehicle/seat/platform/freshness fields explicitly unknown. Selection and follow-up actions use backend messages.
Existing journeys/search, direct/transfer/operator/category/AC/sleeper/budget/time/deadline controls and ranking modes. Existing Phase3B bounds remain.
Direct-service mode, actual station/alias autocomplete, explicit unique station choice and hard constraints. Verified-seat requirement excludes unknown inventory.
Actual ordered variant-aware stops, permissions, scheduled date/time, category, amenities, whole-route fare, cancellation/status/platform/source metadata. Not a live tracking screen.
Server-authorized local token gate, real inventory overview and all requested sections. Domains without compatible writes are explicitly read-only.

Existing CRUD/imports; schema-driven forms and local reference choices, sorting/filtering/column visibility/pagination. Table sort/filter applies to current25-row page; reference selects show up to100.
Protected stateless NLP adapter exposes actual debug payload. Public debug=true now requires admin credentials. Rule confidence is not presented as calibrated probability.
Actual health, fallback/model distinction, DB counts and sources. Import recency unknown because existing batch model has no timestamp.
Production browser tests reject non-local requests; backend fixture rejects outbound external socket connections. No CDN/fonts/analytics/remote images. OS firewall isolation not executed.
Desktop1440x1000 and mobile390x844 inspected; browser tests check navigation and page overflow. Not an exhaustive device/accessibility certification.

Backend admin/diagnostic authorization, random owner capabilities, safe React text, CSP, security headers, body/rate limits, no bundled secret. Single-process local token model; no enterprise identity directory.
19 actual production-browser tests and1388 backend tests passed, plus frontend lint/build, Ruff, Mypy and zero-vulnerability npm audit.
start-rtc.ps1 dev and production modes both started successfully against existing DB; no runtime downloads. Production serves dist through FastAPI without Node.
Passenger/admin pages, integration, tests, scripts and docs exist and were run. Broader backend capability and production verification remain incomplete.
